name: GoalTracker
subtitle: Your casual football games, remembered.
description: Goals, assists and a match calendar for your Garmin Forerunner 970.

apps.name: GoalTracker
apps.subtitle: Goals, assists and match days
apps.localizedDescription: Track casual football games inside the standard Garmin Football activity. Download saved goals and assists from Garmin Connect, add notes, browse your calendar and see your totals. Garmin import requires the GoalTracker data field and a Garmin Personal API key; manual match logging works independently.

versions.localizedDescription:
GoalTracker 1.3.0 (6)

Download your saved Football stats directly from Garmin Connect. You no longer need to reopen GoalTracker on the watch to transfer a match.

Set up your Garmin Personal API key in Settings → Garmin Connect. The key stays securely in this iPhone’s Keychain. Save Football and let Garmin Connect upload it as usual, then pull down on Matches to import Goals and Assists.

Automatic checks retain the one-hour cooldown. Pull-to-refresh and the header syncing indicator remain available. Newly downloaded saved matches count in statistics automatically. Existing match notes, names and statistics choices are preserved; matching older watch logs are linked without adding duplicates.

Requires an internet connection, a Garmin Personal API key and the GoalTracker watch field. Garmin 1.0.1 already records the required fields; update to Garmin 1.0.2 to remove the old 30-log recording limit. Authenticated import of a real activity still needs verification after setup on your iPhone.

GoalTracker 1.2.2 (build 5)

- Automatic sync now waits one hour between attempts, including failed attempts, and remembers the cooldown across app launches.
- Pull down on Matches to sync immediately. Manual requests bypass the cooldown and restart its timer.
- A spinner and Syncing… indicator appear in the Matches header while waiting for completion, an error, or timeout.
- The sync result appears on Matches. Repeated pulls join the existing request instead of sending duplicates.
- Queued-batch progress waits for distinct logs, and timeout messages distinguish no response from an incomplete transfer.

Update through the existing AltStore source. Existing history is preserved. No additional Garmin field update is required for these phone changes. Keep GoalTracker visible inside Football and the iPhone app open during transfer; Garmin Connect activity history uses a separate sync path.

All 17 Swift core tests pass. Header layout was checked in a simulator UI fixture with a simulated transfer; a physical-watch transfer still needs validation.

GoalTracker 1.2.1 (build 4)

- Sync match history now shows progress, actionable Garmin errors, and a 30-second timeout.
- The updated Garmin field reports queued logs, an empty queue, or an active session.
- Retained offline counters are recovered for review when no recording is active, even if the original reset callback was missed.
- Reopening the iPhone app preserves an already ready watch connection. Last received persists across launches.

Update both the iPhone app and the GoalTracker Garmin data field in place. Display GoalTracker inside Football and keep the iPhone app open for transfer. Confirm received games before counting them in statistics.

Existing match history is preserved. Garmin Connect activity sync remains separate. Twelve Swift and twelve Garmin simulator tests pass; physical-device transfer still needs validation.

GoalTracker 1.2 (build 3)

- Dark mode enabled by default, with Dark / Light / System choices in Settings → Appearance.
- Adaptive green accents for readable contrast in both themes.
- Includes typed playing time, 90-minute / 20:00 defaults, combined month and weekday filters, and expanded statistics from 1.1.
- Existing history is preserved. Update through the same AltStore Classic source.

The Garmin private beta uses the simplified two-card counter. Final Garmin store submission remains pending contact-email and developer-terms approval.

GoalTracker 1.1 (build 2)

- Faster manual game entry: type minutes with the number pad. New games default to 90 minutes and 20:00 on the selected day.
- Filter statistics by weekday and month together with year/all-years.
- Added assists and contributions per game, per-90 rates, average playing time, scoring/contribution consistency, hat-tricks and best game records.
- Existing match history and Garmin-recorded times are preserved.

10 core tests pass. Physical-watch touch/sync, Garmin Connect summaries and AltStore re-signing still require device validation.
First beta: native Football touch counter, offline watch logs, match calendar and statistics. Physical-device sync and AltStore installation still need validation.
